expectations.text: Avoids commodity language and vendor positioning
expectations.evidence: Eliminates 'high-quality renders', 'price per item' pricing, deliverable mechanics; rejects vendor thinking throughout; no 'revisions per image' or production-centric language.

expectations.text: Connects to business outcome (sales, decisions, risk, alignment)
expectations.evidence: Corrected version identifies five specific outcomes: pre-selling/faster conversions, investor/lender approval, stakeholder alignment, design validation/risk reduction, market differentiation/premium positioning.

expectations.text: Positions Rendimension as strategic partner, not vendor
expectations.evidence: Shifts from 'here are 5 renders' to 'what problem are we solving?'; positions Rendimension as strategic advisor; forces client self-identification of need; original scored 1/5, corrected 5/5 on positioning alignment.

Corrected version opens with outcome interrogation, not deliverables; every option presented maps to specific business result; scope/timeline/investment framed as following from problem solved, not from item count.

expectations.text: Would pass Hugo's review without edits
expectations.evidence: Explicitly approved: 'APPROVED FOR CLIENT USE'; maintains brand integrity; can support $10K-$50K strategic engagement vs. original $500 transaction; protects positioning and credibility.
